mentions.name: Godot Mountain Biking Simulation Game
mentions.description: A simulation-style mountain biking game built in Godot with the simulation core written in Rust. Aims for a controllable, realistic-feeling bike with POV gameplay and an action-cam feel, dual-stick controls separating rider hip movement from bike lean, an automated steering controller handling counter-steering, physics-based manuals and hops, simulated dirt using MPM coupled with rigid bodies, and Squamish-style rolls and freeride features.
mentions.problem: Modeling intuitive bike controls has proven difficult: steering can't be player-controlled directly because counter-steering is too fast and unintuitive, and forces through the bottom bracket for manuals, hops, and pumping have not yet been achieved despite multiple control sets and physics approaches.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a simulation-esque mountain biking game in my spare time. I'm making it in Godot and am writing the simulation core in rust.
